{{Otheruses|Algae}}
The '''Algae Sward''' was an equatorial sea on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]</ref>

It was famous because, once a year, thousands of one-celled plants bloomed at once, so that the sea became green-tinted. South of the [[Algae/Legends|Algae]] Sward were the [[Seascape Mountains]], a range of underwater peaks and home of [[Whaladon/Legends|whaladons]].<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" />

During the [[Battle of Calamari]], [[World Devastator]] ''[[Nullifier-5]]'' became inoperative just over the Sward. It was then submerged under twenty meters of water, with inactive repulsors. The [[Mon Calamari Council|Calamarian Council]] considered it too expensive to salvage, so it was only stripped of its control system. In the following years, it became a home for the native sea life, including [[Krakana/Legends|krakanas]], [[sussimi]]s and [[nano-star]]s. Some sport drivers also started mapping its interior.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" />

Eventually, the ''Nullifier-5'' was found to be leaking toxins that could potentially poison the entire Sward. Specialists were called in to prevent the ecological disaster in the making.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" />
